pages.text: 每种物品都有其$(thing)体积 ⇲ $()和$(thing)重量 ⚖$() 。物品的体积和重量会显示在其$(thing)工具提示$()中，将鼠标悬停在物品上就能查看。

Size determines what $(l:logistics/storage)Storage$() blocks an item can fit inside.$(br)$(li)$(thing)Tiny$() items fit in anything.$(li)$(thing)Very Small$() items fit in anything.$(li)$(thing)Small$() items are the largest item that will fit in $(l:craftsmanship/pottery)Small Vessels$()$().$(li)$(thing)Normal$() items are the largest that will fit in $(l:craftsmanship/pottery)Large Vessels$().
pages.title: 体积 ⇲

pages.text: $(li)$(thing)Large$() items are the largest that will fit in $(l:logistics/storage#chests)Chests$(). $(l:craftsmanship/pit_kiln)Pit Kilns$() can hold four.$(li)$(thing)Very Large$() items are placed alone in Pit Kilns.$(li)$(thing)Huge$() items do not fit in most storage devices. They also count towards overburdening.
物品的重量决定了它一组可堆叠的上限。$(br)$(li)$(thing)非常轻$()：64$(li)$(thing)轻$()：32$(li)$(thing)中等$()：16$(li)$(thing)重$()：4$(li)$(thing)非常重$()：1$(br2)大部分物品都属于$(thing)非常轻$()的类别。方块一般都是$(thing)中等$()重量。
pages.title: 重量 ⚖
负担过重
pages.text: 物品栏中存在$(thing)极大$()且$(thing)非常重$()的物品会使你$(thing)负担过重$()。只要携带一件$(thing)极大、非常重$()的物品就会导致你变得疲惫，饥饿值也会消耗得更快。携带两件以上就会使你进入$(thing)负担过重$()状态，行动也会变得极其缓慢。

Items that count towards overburdening include $(thing)Anvils$(), $(thing)Sealed Barrels$(), and $(thing)Crucibles$() (with contents).$(br2)Note: $(l:agriculture/animal_husbandry#equines)Horses$() can also be overburdened.$(br2)Raising your $(l:cooking/food_and_water#protein)Protein$() stat allows you to carry an additional item without being overburdened.
